author: HBO Max
description:
Horror meets the DC Universe! On Season 2, Episode 13 of DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, Frankey and Coy welcome film commentator Megan Cruz (@jstoobs) for a deep dive into horror cinema, comic book culture, and DC Studios' Clayface. From why Clayface is such a bold move for the DCU to the connection between horror and superhero storytelling, this is an episode every horror and DC fan needs to hear.

Megan, Frankey, and Coy get into:

✅ Why Clayface could be one of the boldest moves in the DC Universe, bringing full-on body horror into the superhero genre
✅ How horror reflects the cultural moment, from Night of the Living Dead to today's horror renaissance
✅ Why Batman, Scarecrow, Arkham Asylum, and even Swamp Thing have always had a place in DC's horror legacy
✅ Megan's take on what makes horror work, why the genre is becoming more mainstream, and the movies that helped shape her perspective
✅ The ultimate body-horror ranking game! Megan weighs in on The Fly, The Substance
title: DC Studios Showcase Official Podcast | Megan Cruz on Clayface & Body Horror | HBO Max
